ctx.x: Johnny Dot. That was when you first got here? When I first got here. Yeah.

items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: I remember Johnny Dodds. I heard about Jimmy Noon but I never did have a chance to meet Jimmy.

ctx.x: Did you get through all your questions there? Yes, I think so. If you can think of something else, anything else that you'd like to ask about. I was going to ask much more if you knew for sure if people like Johnny Dodds or Jimmy Noon put their teeth on the instrument too. Do you think you remember? No.
I remember Johnny Dodds. I heard about Jimmy Noon but I never did have a chance to meet Jimmy.
I met him and of course I didn't pay much attention to him.
